title: Podshelf
shortDescription: A podcast player for your own Audiobookshelf server.
fullDescription:
Podshelf is a podcast player for Android, built around catching up rather than browsing.

IMPORTANT: Podshelf requires an Audiobookshelf server that you or someone you know is hosting. It provides no content of its own and is not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project.

CATCH UP
• A single feed of unplayed episodes across your podcast libraries, oldest first, on the home screen.
• Play next picks up where you left off without hunting through shows.
• An automatic playlist of everything you have not finished, built on the device.
• Per-podcast rules: exclude a show from the auto playlist, or keep only its latest few unplayed episodes, so one back catalogue does not bury everything else.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• Auto-cache unplayed episodes in the background so they are ready without a connection.
• Disconnect deliberately and keep the normal app around you — your library layout, the catch-up feed, your downloads — rather than dropping to a bare file list.
• Reachability is judged by whether your server actually answered, not by whether the radio is up, so patchy coverage and captive portals behave sensibly instead of stalling.

IN THE CAR AND ON YOUR WRIST
• Android Auto browsing and playback with a working queue, skip and seek actions, and playback speed.
• A proper media session, so lock screen, notification, watch and headset controls all work.
• Google Cast support.

BUILT FOR BIG SCREENS
• Adapts past the point where Android treats a display as large, instead of stretching phone layouts.
• On a foldable propped open, the player lays the artwork out above the hinge rather than across it.

PRIVACY
Podshelf has no servers and no accounts. There is no analytics, no crash reporting and no advertising of any kind. Your library, your listening history and your credentials stay between your device and the server you configure. The only other service contacted is Podcast Index, and only when you search for a new podcast to add.

OPEN SOURCE
Podshelf is free software under the GPL-3.0, forked from the Audiobookshelf mobile app. The full source is public.
